rationale: Probability and ordinal-prototype transfer showed weak source gains and no advantage over the target training-mean baseline externally. Evaluate objective alignment before claiming a depth-transfer benefit.
corn: Conditional survival binary cross-entropy summed over eligible decisions and divided by eligible count; predicted score 2 + sum of cumulative products of conditional probabilities
selection: Lowest inner-validation continuous-score MAE; ties retain earlier epoch; no model checkpoint selected on test
feature_transfer: Cosine distance from an RGB-student linear projector to a frozen, validation-selected teacher's mean episode feature. RGB self-teacher controls generic regularisation; RGBD teacher supplies paired depth.
negative_control: Keep target RGB teacher feature, reassign depth branch features from a different training animal within native-depth-width-majority strata where possible, with replacement. Map and fallback flags saved.
source_scale: Original reported beef scale 1-9, observed folder labels 2-6
novelty_position: A controlled empirical evaluation in this BCS setting; scalar regression, CORN and feature distillation are existing methods. No first-method or SOTA claim is prespecified.
